class.name: AssetTagsEditorPlugin
class.brief_description: Editor plugin for managing asset tags.
class.description: Adds an [b]Asset Tags[/b] tab to the Project Settings dialog for managing the project tag dictionary: browsing the tag tree, editing comments, renaming or removing tags, and cleaning up unused tags. Per-asset tag assignment is available from the FileSystem dock context menu via [b]Edit Asset Tags...[/b]. Coordinates with [AssetTagManager], [AssetTagRegistry], and [AssetTagCoordinator] for undo-aware mutations.
